mods.name: Deck Meters
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: A level meter for each deck with a clip warning, and a flash in the deck color when a drop hits.
mods.description:
Test build 0.1.0: validated and harness-tested, not yet run on a deck. One bar per deck from the deck's own output before the mixer: green, amber near the top, and a red mark held for a second when the track hits full scale. When a playing deck's energy jumps after a quieter stretch, a band in that deck's color flashes across the top of the screen.

Mod Menu rows: meters on/off and position, drop flash on/off and its sensitivity.

Reads each deck's audio through the core's audio tap, read-only: no hooks, controls, LEDs, files or network.

mods.name: FLOW Beat Link
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Sends each deck's beat, BPM, play state and track to FLOW VJ over the network, to lock visuals and lights.
mods.description:
Rows: Send beat to FLOW (on) and Send mixer data (test) (off).

Sends UDP packets on the deck's network (Wi-Fi or LINK), broadcast to port 9100 unless flow-beat:host in MODS/azmods.cfg names one computer: each new beat, each deck's BPM and beat position 50 times a second, track title and artist, and each deck's own audio level and bass (read before the hardware mixer). FLOW VJ listens for them.

Read-only: it does not patch the deck, change controls or audio, or write files.

mods.name: Grouped Deck Panels
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Deck headers with key, phrase and mix hints in 4 DECK, 2/4 DECK and 2 DECK.
mods.description: Input-transparent deck headers beside the stock BPM: title, original Camelot key, relative phrase counter. Mix hints: key turns green/amber/red against the longest-playing other deck, the deck number turns amber at 30 s and red at 10 s left, a dot shows stems (filled = playing, hollow = found), and a small BPM gap appears within 8 BPM. Works in 4 DECK, 2/4 DECK and 2 DECK (Two-deck view: Auto follows the last layout tab tapped, or pick it). No audio, tempo, key or library changes.

mods.name: Harmonic Picks
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: A Mod Menu page listing tracks on your stick that fit the playing deck by key and BPM.
mods.description:
Test build 0.1.0: validated and harness-tested, not yet run on a deck. Open Mod Menu > Community Mods > Installed > Harmonic Picks. It takes the deck that started playing last and lists up to 40 tracks from your USB sticks in the same key, a neighbour key or the relative key, within 6% BPM (half and double time count). Same key shows green. Each row shows key, BPM, BPM gap and the track; VOX marks acapellas.

Turn the knob to scroll. Press to switch between all tracks and acapellas only.

Reads deck state and the stick's library through the AZ-MODS core only: no hooks, controls, LEDs, audio, files or network.

mods.name: Key next to BPM
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: The song, key and BPM at the start of each waveform lane, or just the key next to the BPM.
mods.description:
Puts each deck's song, key and BPM at the start of its waveform lane, so in 4 DECK you can see what's on every lane without looking down. Tested in the emulator in 4 DECK; not yet run on a deck.

Mod Menu rows: Show (Song+key, or Key only at the end of the lane), notation (Camelot 8A, classic Am, as exported), size, position and a nudge. Keys come from the stick's rekordbox library on the mod's own thread.

Runs with whatever share of the deck's 16 surfaces other mods leave. Read-only: no hooks, controls, LEDs, audio, files or network.

mods.name: Mashup Helper
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Do the two decks in play go together? Camelot key match and the pitch gap, on one line.
mods.description:
Test build 0.1.0: validated and harness-tested, not yet run on a deck. One line for the two decks you are mixing (the two that started playing last): both keys in Camelot, then SAME or MATCH in green (same key, a neighbour, or the relative key), BOOST in amber (two steps round the wheel) or CLASH in red, and the pitch gap between the two tracks' original tempos, half and double time included.

Keys and tempos come from the stick's rekordbox library, read on the mod's own thread. Mod Menu rows: on/off, pitch gap on/off, top or bottom.

Reads deck state and the library through the AZ-MODS core only: no hooks, controls, LEDs, audio, files or network.

mods.name: MODS Shortcut
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Hide the WAVEFORM heading and use MODS to open SOURCE for the official Mod Menu.
mods.description: SDK-only community mod. MODS opens SOURCE; select MOD MENU to open the official menu. 0.1.3 registers spare input lanes and moves to the next when the core switches one off, dims the button with a SOURCE > MOD MENU message when none remain, and logs each tap's outcome. Physical navigation and LOAD cancel the shortcut. Hide WAVEFORM heading blanks only its title area; touches pass through. Official core timing protections are unchanged. No track loading, audio or library writes.

mods.name: 4-Deck Phase Strip
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Classic-size phase meter restored, with 3-1-2-4 lane order.
mods.description: Restores the larger 0.1.1 meter (838 by 47 px), centered marker and saved Top/Band/Low positions, retaining lanes 3, 1, 2, 4. Top spans y46-92 and may overlap the waveform band; Band and Low can overlap other native content. The marker is independent of native left/center playhead settings. Mod Menu: on/off, 4 DECK only or all layouts, and position. Ticks show beats, not phrases. SDK services only; input-transparent display, no hooks or audio/control changes. Physical testing of this correction is pending.

mods.name: Phrase Coach
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: A bar counter on each deck: bar 5 of 8, amber in the last bar, green on the new phrase.
mods.description:
Test build 0.1.0: validated and harness-tested, not yet run on a deck. Shows where each deck is in its phrase: the bar number (for example 5/8) and one cell per bar that fills beat by beat. The last bar before the next phrase turns amber, and the first beat of a new phrase flashes green.

The deck's beat grid has no bar position, so the count starts on the beat nearest the moment the deck first plays after a load. Start tracks from a cue on the first downbeat and the count is right. If it is off, Phrase starts now in the Mod Menu sets bar 1 on the deck you started last. Hot cues, loops and beat jumps keep the count; a ? means it was lost.

Mod Menu rows: on/off, phrase length (8 or 16 bars), position, and Phrase starts now.

Reads deck state and the beat grid through the AZ-MODS core only: no hooks, controls, LEDs, audio, files or network.

mods.name: Set Clock
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Time left in your set, plus a warning in the last minute of the playing track.
mods.description:
Test build 0.1.0: validated and harness-tested, not yet run on a deck. Shows SET and the time left in your set, counting down from the set length you pick (1 to 4 hours) once the first deck plays. Amber in the last 10 minutes, red once you run over. In the last minute of the playing track it adds END and that deck's time left, flashing red in the last 20 seconds.

Mod Menu rows: on/off, set length, track warning on/off, position, and Restart set timer.

Reads deck state through the AZ-MODS core only: no hooks, controls, LEDs, audio, files or network.

mods.name: Set Log
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Writes every track you play to a CSV on your USB stick: your tracklist, ready after the gig.
mods.description:
Test build 0.1.0: validated and harness-tested, not yet run on a deck. A track counts once it has played for 30 seconds in one go, so cueing and previewing don't. Each one becomes a line in a CSV in MODS/community-mods/set-log/data on the stick: number, time into the set, clock time, deck, artist, title, BPM, length and rekordbox id. A new file starts after a reboot, after 30 minutes with nothing playing, or from Start a new set in the Mod Menu.

Mod Menu rows: on/off, a short note on screen when a track is logged, and Start a new set.

Reads deck state through the AZ-MODS core and writes only its own data folder: no hooks, controls, LEDs, audio or network.

mods.name: Stem Badge
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: A badge on each deck that says whether the loaded track has stems, and if they play.
mods.description:
Test build 0.1.0: validated and harness-tested, not yet run on a deck. A small badge on each deck: STEMS in green when the track has stems and the stems engine plays them, STEMS in grey when it has stems but they are off, NO STEMS in red when there are none, so you never reach for a stem pad on a track without stems.

Mod Menu rows: on/off, every deck or only tracks with no stems, and on the deck's row or at the screen top. With decks 3 or 4 in use in the 2/4 DECK view the badges carry their deck number and sit at the top.

Reads deck state through the AZ-MODS core only: no hooks, controls, LEDs, audio, files or network.

mods.name: Crate Remote
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Browse both USBs on an iPad, see what fits, and send a pick to the deck: highlighted, or loaded on a stopped deck.
mods.description: Browse both USBs on an iPad or phone and send a pick to the deck. Open http://crate-remote.local:8765 (or the Wi-Fi or cable address on this mod's page) on the deck's Wi-Fi or a cable to the LINK port, and enter the PIN shown there. Show on deck puts the browser on the track; Load presses LOAD only for a stopped deck and checks the deck got it. It drives the deck's own controls (PLAYLIST, knob, clicks); touching any control stops it. Uses the network (port 8765) and runs avahi-publish for the .local name. Never writes the library.

mods.name: Moment Cards
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Wedding run-of-show on the deck: a big card for each moment a minute ahead, with countdown, song and MC line.
mods.description: Put MOMENTS.txt at the top of the USB, one line per moment: 19:15 | First Dance | Perfect - Ed Sheeran | Couple to the floor. A minute ahead (or 2 or 5) a full-screen card shows the moment, a countdown, the song and whether a deck has it loaded, and the MC line; tap it to shrink it to a small countdown, and a short NOW card shows at the moment. Time zone row for the venue (US daylight saving built in); Show test card to check it. Read-only: no controls, audio or library writes.

mods.name: Dead-Air Guard
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Warns before the room goes silent: LOAD NEXT, ENDING, QUIET and DEAD AIR, as thin edge bars and one label.
mods.description: Amber LOAD NEXT when every deck you can hear ends within 30 s (adjustable) and no other deck has a different track loaded; red ENDING at 10 s; QUIET when audible decks have been near-silent for 4 s; DEAD AIR if the music stops with the mics off. A deck playing with its channel fader down doesn't count as heard. A mic or TALK OVER switch on silences DEAD/QUIET during speeches. Shows as thin top/bottom bars and one small label, never over the Mod Menu. Read-only: watches the mixer input and each deck's audio level, changes nothing.

mods.name: Pad Lights
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: The pads as a light show when idle; optional key-coloured beat pulse or 32-beat phrase countdown.
mods.description: Idle show (default): the pads glow in a slow colour wave on a side whose deck is stopped or empty, so the deck you're playing keeps its own hot-cue colours. Beat pulse: the playing side's pads pulse on every beat in a colour from the track's key. Phrase countdown: the pads fill over 32 beats from when the track started, and the last bar flashes red. Off returns every pad to normal. Changes pad colours only: no controls, audio or library writes.

mods.name: Reel Marks
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: SHIFT + TAP marks a moment worth a clip; a Mac script cuts the clips for reels.
mods.description: Press SHIFT + TAP (the Beat FX TAP button) during a set to mark a moment. Each mark saves the time, the minutes into the set and every loaded deck's track, position and BPM to MODS/community-mods/reel-marks/data/marks-<date>.csv on the USB, and shows a short banner. On the Mac, tools/reel_cut.py cuts a clip around each mark from your phone video or recording. SHIFT + TAP never reaches the deck; TAP alone works as usual. Writes only its own file on the USB.

mods.name: Custom Screen
mods.author: hleawilliams-commits
mods.summary: Your own deck-screen panels from a text file: readouts, 4-deck rekordbox waveforms and FlowVJ's status.
mods.description: Up to four click-through panels on the deck screen, each holding the readouts you pick: deck number, title, artist, key (green/amber/red against the other playing deck), BPM, BPM gap, BPMs that fit, pitch move, phrase meter (4/8/16 bars from rekordbox's grid), beat dots, time left, stems, play state, LEFT/RIGHT, clock, text, boxes, zoomed and whole-track rekordbox waveforms for all four decks (from the USB's analysis), and FlowVJ's look, lights and LOCK/SAFE/HOLD with tap buttons back to FlowVJ (UDP 9102/9103). The layout comes from layout.txt on the USB, re-read within a second. No audio, tempo, key, control or library changes.
